Account.description: Profile-owned account metadata. Credentials remain with the native provider.

AccountCreateRequest.description: `account.create`: register a new native account home for a provider.

name.description: Trimmed by the daemon; 1 to 80 characters without line breaks.

AccountDisableRequest.description: `account.disable`: stop new ADE launches with this account.

AccountDisabled.description: The `account.disable` reply. ADE never logs the native CLI out.

AccountInspectRequest.description: `account.inspect`: probe a managed account's native readiness.

AccountVerifyRequest.description: `account.verify`: pin the identity an earlier `account.inspect` returned.

expected_generation.description:
The `generation` from `account.inspect`. Required on the wire; the
daemon reports its absence after it has found the account.

AgentAccountInspectRequest.description:
`agent.account_inspect`: probe a provider account's native status. The
profile daemon sends it on the runtime socket; `token` is its owner token.

AgentAccountInspection.description: The `agent.account_inspect` reply: an untagged account inspection.

identity.description: The provider-specific identity, when the account is ready.

AgentAnswerRequest.description: `agent.answer`: answer a pending provider request by its ID.

answers.description: Structured answers; required by the `answer` decision.

AgentChildTranscriptRequest.description: `agent.child_transcript`: one page of a provider child agent's transcript.

cursor.description: Provider page cursor, at most 4096 bytes.

message_id.description: The parent message that records the child agents.

offset.description: Item offset; the daemon uses 0 when it is absent and allows at most 100000.

AgentListRequest.description:
`agent.list`: the runtime supervisor's live Agent runs. The profile daemon
sends it on the runtime socket; `token` is the daemon's owner token.

AgentRun.description: One live Agent run in the runtime supervisor.

commands.description: Command keys the run holds receipts for.

pid.description: The provider process ID, when the adapter has one.

AgentRunSpec.description: The identity an Agent run was created with.

account.description: The pinned account execution context, or null for ambient credentials.

AgentSendRequest.description: `agent.send`: submit a prompt. `request_id` is the caller-owned operation ID.

AgentSendReviewRequest.description:
`agent.send_review`: submit a prompt that carries review feedback.
`request_id` is the caller-owned send identity shared with the draft send
intent. Exactly one of `review_anchor` and `review_feedback` is present.

attachments.description: Review prompts reject attachments; an empty list is accepted.

AttachmentImportRequest.description:
`attachment.import`: attach a regular file that the daemon reads from disk.
`request_id` becomes the attachment ID.

AttachmentInspectRequest.description: `attachment.inspect`: read a live attachment's metadata and digest.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the payload.

AttachmentPutRequest.description: `attachment.put`: upload attachment bytes. `request_id` becomes the attachment ID.

data.description: Standard base64 of the file bytes.

AttachmentReclaim.description: The `attachment.reclaim.apply` reply; `attachment` is the state after reclaim.

expected_generation.description: The preview's `generation`; a changed attachment is refused.

AttachmentReclaimPreview.description: One attachment's retention state and what protects it from reclaim.

automatic_gc_eligible.description: Always false: only an explicit reclaim frees an attachment.

AttachmentReclaimPreviewRequest.description: `attachment.reclaim.preview`: report what reclaiming one attachment would free.

BranchPolicy.description: What `worktree.remove` does with the removed tree's branch.

oneOf.description: Delete the branch only if Git reports it merged.

BrowserListRequest.description: `browser.list`: list the tabs under one exact owner.

BrowserMutation.description:
The `browser.open`, `browser.navigate` and `browser.close` reply, relayed
from the owner. `payload_fingerprint` is the daemon's fingerprint of the
operation, its profile, owner, tab and URL.

BrowserNavigateRequest.description: `browser.navigate`: load a URL in an exact tab.

BrowserOpenRequest.description:
`browser.open`: open a tab. `operation_id` is the caller-owned operation
ID; the daemon still accepts it as `request_id`.

url.description: An `http://` or `https://` URL of at most 8192 bytes.

BrowserOperation.description: The `browser.operation` reply: the daemon's receipt, or the owner's.

op.description: The mutation's operation; only the owner's receipt carries it.

result.description:
The completed mutation's reply. The daemon's receipt sends `null`
before completion; the owner's omits it without a tab.

BrowserOperationRequest.description: `browser.operation`: read a browser mutation's receipt by its operation ID.

profile_id.description: Defaults to this daemon's browser profile.

oneOf.description: The daemon admitted the mutation and has no outcome yet.
The outcome was lost; inspect before another action.

BrowserOwnerGetRequest.description: `browser.owner.get`: read the live browser owner of a profile.

profile_id.description: Defaults to this daemon's browser profile.

BrowserOwnerRegisterRequest.description: `browser.owner.register`: name the Unix socket that owns the profile's browser.

socket_path.description: An absolute path to a private, owned Unix socket.

BrowserTabRecord.description: One browser tab as the owner reports it. The owner uses camelCase names.

BrowserTabReply.description: The `browser.inspect` reply, relayed from the owner.

BrowserTabs.description: The `browser.list` reply, relayed from the owner.

CatalogFrame.description: The `catalog.get` reply and the `catalog` feed frame.

CatalogGetRequest.description: `catalog.get`: read the profile's workspaces, conversations and windows.

ChildTranscriptPage.description:
The `agent.child_transcript` reply, passed through from the provider bridge.
Offset-paged providers send `next_offset` (null on the last page); cursor-paged
providers send `next_cursor` instead.

directory.description: Parent directory for new trees; the repository's parent when absent.

ConversationCreateRequest.description: `conversation.create`: make a Conversation in a workspace.

account_id.description: A managed account of the same provider.

provider_config.description: Provider settings; the daemon validates them for the provider.

title.description: Defaults to `New Conversation`; at most 256 bytes.

ConversationCreated.description: The `conversation.create` reply: an `ack` carrying the new Conversation.

ConversationGetRequest.description: `conversation.get`: one page of a conversation's messages, newest first.

before.description: Return messages with a sequence below this one.

limit.description: Page size; the daemon uses 50 when it is absent.

DaemonHello.description: The `hello` reply: build identity and every protocol version.

build_id.description: `ADE_BUILD_ID`, or `null` when the daemon was built without one.

Descriptor.description:
The daemon advertises the same contract it uses to validate configuration.
Clients consume descriptors; they do not infer support from a provider name.

session_worktree_leases.description: Worktree leases the session layer holds for service and script terminals.

terminal_worktree_leases.description: Workspaces whose worktree lease a live terminal holds.

build_id.description: `ADE_BUILD_ID`, or `null` when the daemon was built without one.

host_key.description:
A stable, non-reversible key for this host: 16 hex digits of the
SHA-256 of its host name, or `unknown`.

DiagnosticLive.description: Live execution as the runtime reports it.

observed.description:
False when the runtime could not be asked; runs and terminals are then
empty and every service's `running` is `null`.

DiagnosticLogs.description: The local diagnostic log folder against its budget.

daily_byte_budget.description: Bytes one process may write to its current daily file.

DiagnosticProvenance.description: How far a reported number can be trusted.

oneOf.description: Read from the owner of the state at report time.
Counted in memory or over a partial window; `note` says which.
The source could not be read; the value is absent.

DiagnosticQueue.description: The depth of one queue or spool.

capacity.description: The bound, when the queue has one.

DiagnosticReceipts.description: Effect receipts in one database, counted by status.

available.description: False when the database could not be read; every count is then zero.

oldest_created_at.description: Creation time of the oldest unexpired receipt, in Unix milliseconds.

other.description: Rows with a status this build does not know.

past_retention.description: Unexpired receipts older than the retention window, awaiting pruning.

DiagnosticRedaction.description: What redaction removed from a bundle.

credential_fields.description: Values dropped because their key names a credential.

transcript_fields.description: Values dropped because their key names transcript or output content.

truncations.description: Strings, arrays, objects or nesting cut to their bounds.

attachment_bytes.description: Bytes of stored attachment data, or `null` when unreadable.

receipts_past_retention.description: Receipts past retention across every readable store, awaiting pruning.

DiagnosticRun.description: One live Agent run in the runtime.

account_pinned.description:
Whether the run holds a pinned account context. The context itself is
never reported.

DiagnosticService.description: One configured service and whether its terminal is live.

last_run_transfer_id.description: The incarnation of the service's last run.

running.description: `null` when the runtime was not observed.

exit_kind.description: The recorded exit kind, when the shell exited.

DiagnosticUnit.description: The unit a queue gauge counts.

DiagnosticUnknown.description: One execution whose outcome ADE cannot prove, and why.

operation.description: The operation name, for a receipt.

scope.description: The store or workspace that holds it.

since.description: When it was last updated, in Unix milliseconds.

subject.description: The operation, Conversation, terminal or claim subject.

DiagnosticUnknownSource.description: Where an unknown execution was found.

oneOf.description: An effect receipt in `unknown` status.
A lease the daemon could not resolve after a restart.
A runtime terminal whose exit could not be verified.
A Conversation whose run was interrupted or disconnected.
The runtime itself could not be observed.

DiagnosticUnresolvedClaim.description: A lease the daemon holds as unresolved.

holds_worktree.description: Whether the unresolved lease still holds the worktree lease.

incarnation.description: The run or terminal incarnation the lease expects, when recorded.

subject.description: The Conversation ID, service name or script run ID.

oneOf.description: Since this daemon process started; a restart resets it.
Summed over the runtime's current terminal incarnations only.

DiagnosticsExport.description: The `diagnostics.export` reply: a bounded, redacted, inspectable bundle.

events.description:
Allow-listed operational log records, oldest first. Each carries only
known fields: event, timestamp, process, pid, diagnostic and run IDs,
operation family, elapsed time and fixed error codes.

events_truncated.description: Whether older records were left out to meet a bound.

max_bytes.description: The bound the serialized bundle stays under.

DiagnosticsExportRequest.description:
`diagnostics.export`: build a bounded, redacted diagnostics bundle. The
daemon returns it; the caller decides where to save it.

max_events.description:
The most recent operational log records to include, from 0 to 1000.
Defaults to 200.

degraded.description: Fixed descriptions of sources that could not be read.

unknown_truncated.description: Whether `unknown` was cut to its bound.

DiagnosticsStatusRequest.description:
`diagnostics.status`: read queue, counter, receipt, execution, claim and
retention state, with the reasons behind every unknown execution.

Draft.description: The schema of [`Draft`], which the model defines without one.

DraftGetRequest.description: `draft.get`: read one window's draft of a Conversation.

DraftSaveRequest.description: `draft.save`: store a newer draft revision for one window.

expected_revision.description: Resolve a conflict: save only if the stored revision is still this one.

DraftSendAbortRequest.description: `draft.send.abort`: release a send the daemon rejected before admission.

DraftSendAcknowledgeRequest.description:
`draft.send.acknowledge`: settle one listed send once the caller has shown
its outcome. An accepted prompt completes; a rejected one aborts. A prompt
the daemon has not accepted is refused, because only delivery can settle it.

DraftSendCompleteRequest.description: `draft.send.complete`: clear the draft once the prompt was accepted.

DraftSendGetRequest.description: `draft.send.get`: read the window's unresolved send intent.

DraftSendListRequest.description:
`draft.send.list`: list one window's unresolved sends across Conversations,
ordered by Conversation ID. A later page sends the previous `next_cursor`.

limit.description: Page size from 1 to 200; the daemon uses 50 when it is absent.

DraftSendPrepareRequest.description:
`draft.send.prepare`: record the exact prompt and draft before dispatch.
`request_id` is the send's ID and becomes the accepted message's ID.

ExecutionState.description: Whether a service's recorded run is live in the current runtime.

FileEntry.description: One entry in a listing or search result.

name.description: Display name; a name that is not UTF-8 is shown lossily.

path.description:
Workspace-relative path. A non-UTF-8 component is encoded as U+E000
followed by its unpadded URL-safe Base64 bytes.

size.description: Byte size of a regular file; null for every other kind.

FileKind.description: A directory entry's type, read without following symbolic links.

next_cursor.description: Null when the directory has no more entries.

FileListRequest.description: `file.list`: one page of a workspace directory.

cursor.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page for the same path.

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 100; the daemon uses 100 when it is absent.

path.description: Workspace-relative directory; the workspace root when absent or empty.

FilePreview.description:
The `file.preview` reply. `text` carries `mime` and `text`; `image` carries
`mime` and `bytes_base64`; `unsupported` carries neither.

truncated.description: True when the file exceeds the 256 KiB preview limit.

FilePreviewRequest.description: `file.preview`: the bounded contents of one workspace file.

incomplete.description: True when depth, path-length or directory limits cut the search short.

next_cursor.description: Null when the search has finished.

FileSearchRequest.description: `file.search`: one page of entries whose name contains the query, ignoring case.

cursor.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page for the same query.

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 100; the daemon uses 100 when it is absent.

backup_path.description: Where a discard kept the displaced file.

code.description: The failure code; present and null on a failure without one.

recovery.description: The recovery hint; present and null on a failure without one.

result.description:
The success result: `{head, output}` for a commit, otherwise
`{changed, action, receipt}`.

oneOf.description: The daemon stopped during the Git step; it will not run again.

HelloRequest.description: `hello`: the handshake every connection sends first.

Inspection.description: A provider's native readiness report for one account.

identity.description: The provider-specific identity to pin; its shape depends on the provider.

state.description: `ready` when the account can be verified.

ListenerListRequest.description: `listener.list`: observe local TCP listeners and service port assignments.

workspace_id.description: Set when the listener belongs to a verified managed service run.

OutputCoverage.description: How much of a run's output the durable spool holds and the reply returns.

OutputCoverageReason.description: Why output coverage is pending or incomplete.

OutputCoverageStatus.description: Whether the returned output covers everything the run produced.

PendingSend.description: One unresolved send and what the daemon knows about it.

next_cursor.description: The cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

restored_from_backup.description: Whether the profile was restored from a backup, which holds its sends.

PortAssignment.description: One service port assignment and who was seen listening on it.

PreviewKind.description: How a preview presents the file.

ProviderListRequest.description: `provider.list`: the providers this daemon can launch.

QueueCancelRequest.description: `queue.cancel`: cancel a queued prompt that has not been submitted.

QueueEnqueueRequest.description: `queue.enqueue`: queue a prompt. `request_id` becomes the queued prompt's ID.

QueuePauseRequest.description: `queue.pause`: pause or resume a Conversation's prompt queue.

Readiness.description: Port readiness; application readiness is never inferred.

oneOf.description: Every verified listener is the service's direct process.
At least one verified listener is a descendant of the direct process.

ReadinessState.description: What the daemon could observe about a running service's ports.

oneOf.description:
The service's process tree listens, but not on every assigned port: it
most likely lost the bind and chose another port. Not ready, not wired.

RepositoryRebindEntry.description: One restored repository. `rebindable` says a saved physical identity exists.

RepositoryRebindListRequest.description: `repository.rebind.list`: restored repositories and whether each needs a path.

RepositoryRebindRequest.description: `repository.rebind`: bind a restored Git repository to a verified checkout.

RepositoryRecord.description: A saved repository as the daemon stores it.

hunk_actions.description:
Whether single hunks can be staged; binary, mode, link and
conflicted changes move only as whole files.

next_cursor.description: The cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

ReviewDiffPageRequest.description:
`review.diff_page`: read one bounded page of a file's diff. A first page
omits `cursor`; a continued page sends the previous `next_cursor`.

expected_token.description: The token of the first page; a changed diff fails as stale.

ReviewDiffRequest.description: `review.diff`: read one file's whole diff, split into hunks.

staged.description: The staged side; the unstaged side when false or absent.

ReviewDiffRow.description: One line of a paged diff.

hunk.description: The header of the hunk the line belongs to.

ReviewDiscardRequest.description: `review.discard`: discard one previewed, tracked, unstaged file change.

diff_token.description: The unstaged diff token the user previewed.

ReviewFeedbackMatch.description: One message whose review notes match a search.

next_cursor.description: The cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

ReviewFeedbackSearchRequest.description: `review.feedback.search`: find saved review notes by file, note text or both.

limit.description: Page size from 1 to 50; the daemon uses 20 when it is absent.

code.description: The two-letter porcelain v2 status code.

ReviewHunkRequest.description: `review.hunk`: stage, or with `staged` unstage, one hunk of a reviewed diff.

hunk.description: The hunk's index in that diff.

token.description: The `review.diff` token the hunk was chosen from.

ReviewOperationAcknowledgeRequest.description:
`review.operation.acknowledge`: record that the person saw an interrupted
Git mutation. The operation never runs again either way.

ReviewOperationAcknowledged.description: The `review.operation.acknowledge` reply. A repeat returns the first time.

acknowledged_at.description: When the person acknowledged it; null while unacknowledged.

truncated.description: More matching operations exist than the reply carries.

ReviewOperationListRequest.description:
`review.operation.list`: the workspace's Git mutations that still need the
person: running ones and interrupted ones not yet acknowledged, newest
first. `include_acknowledged` adds acknowledged interrupted ones.

ReviewOperationReply.description: The reply to every Git mutation and to `review.operation`.

ReviewOperationRequest.description: `review.operation`: read a Git mutation's receipt by its operation ID.

ReviewStageRequest.description: `review.stage`: stage one reviewed file at a status revision.

conflicts.description: How many files are in conflict.

head.description: The HEAD commit, or `(initial)` before the first commit.

index_token.description: Identifies HEAD and the index; `review.commit` must send it back.

revision.description: Identifies the whole status; file mutations must send it back.

ReviewStatusRequest.description:
`review.status`: read Git status for a workspace. Replies within 750 ms of
the last read come from a shared cache unless `force` is true.

ReviewUnstageRequest.description: `review.unstage`: unstage one reviewed file at a status revision.

RuntimePrepareRestartRequest.description: `runtime.prepare_restart`: drain the daemon so a new build can take over.

boot_id.description: The `boot_id` from `runtime.status`; a different daemon refuses.

agents.description: The runtime supervisor's agent runs without their command logs.

terminals.description: The runtime supervisor's terminal list, relayed as it sends it.

RuntimeStatusRequest.description: `runtime.status`: read the daemon and runtime supervisor state.

Script.description: A configured workspace script, as `script.list` returns it.

ScriptInspectRequest.description: `script.inspect`: one run's state and output tail.

tail_bytes.description: Output tail size, 1 to 32768 bytes; the daemon uses 8192 when it is absent.

durable_output.description: The durable spool tail, passed through unchanged.

exit_status.description:

metrics.description: The runtime's terminal metrics, passed through unchanged.

name.description: The script name encoded in the run ID; empty if it does not parse.

output.description: The runtime's live `terminal.tail` reply, passed through unchanged.

ScriptListRequest.description: `script.list`: the workspace's configured package scripts and ADE recipes.

ScriptRetireRequest.description: `script.retire`: remove a stopped run and its retained output.

exit_status.description:
The runtime's exit outcome (`kind` is `success`, `failure`, `signaled`
or `unknown`), present once the runtime reports one.

metrics.description: The runtime's terminal metrics, passed through unchanged.

name.description: The script name encoded in the run ID; empty if it does not parse.

toolchain.description: The selected Node toolchain, on `script.start` of a Node-based script.

exit_status.description:
The runtime's exit outcome (`kind` is `success`, `failure`, `signaled`
or `unknown`), present once the runtime reports one.

metrics.description: The runtime's terminal metrics, passed through unchanged.

name.description: The script name encoded in the run ID; empty if it does not parse.

ScriptRunsRequest.description: `script.runs`: the workspace's registered script runs the runtime still knows.

ScriptStartRequest.description: `script.start`: launch a configured script by name as a supervised PTY.

ScriptStopRequest.description: `script.stop`: stop a run and wait up to five seconds for it to exit.

SendAcknowledged.description: The `draft.send.acknowledge` reply, with the window's current draft.

SendIntent.description: A prompt recorded before dispatch, with the draft it came from.

review_anchor.description: Null unless the send carries one review anchor.

review_feedback.description: Null unless the send carries a review feedback batch.

SendIntentPrepared.description: The `draft.send.prepare` reply: the new or already recorded intent.

SendIntentState.description: The `draft.send.get` reply. `intent` is null when no send is unresolved.

restored_from_backup.description: Whether the profile was restored from a backup, which holds its sends.

SendOutcome.description: What the daemon knows about an unresolved send.

oneOf.description: Recorded, but no accepted message exists. Retry delivery with the same ID.
The prompt was accepted as a message. Acknowledge it to clear the draft.
The daemon rejected it before admission. Acknowledge it to release the draft.
A restored backup holds it until its source outcome is reconciled.

A rejected intent has an accepted message. The records disagree; the
daemon settles neither way.
The accepted prompt's draft was cleared.
The rejected prompt was released; the draft keeps its text.

config.description:
Inlined in schemas: a request's defaults make its required fields differ
from a reply's, so the two cannot share one named definition.

peers.description: Environment variables populated from another managed service in this workspace.

ports.description: Environment variables that receive stable, host-local TCP ports.

identity.description: Durable incarnation; a removed service with the same name gets a new ID.

launch_peers.description: URLs placed in the environment of the currently reserved service run.

ServiceChanged.description: The `service_changed` feed frame, sent when a run starts or stops.

metrics.description: The launched terminal's metrics; present when a run starts.

ServiceConfigureRequest.description: `service.configure`: create or edit a service recipe.

config.description:
Decoded as a [`Config`] by the handler, so malformed recipes keep the
daemon's own validation messages.

peers.description: Environment variables populated from another managed service in this workspace.

ports.description: Environment variables that receive stable, host-local TCP ports.

revision.description: The revision the caller last saw; 0 creates the service.

metrics.description: The runtime terminal metrics, or null when the service has no live terminal.

ServiceHealthSampleRequest.description: `service.health.sample`: probe the service's configured health policy now.

ServiceInspectRequest.description: `service.inspect`: execution, readiness, peers and bounded output of one service.

health_check.description:
A one-off HTTP probe. The handler validates it, so its messages stay
specific.

tail_bytes.description: Output tail in bytes, 1 to 32768; the daemon uses 8192 when it is absent.

current_peer_endpoints.description: Absent when the service changed during inspection.

durable_logs.description: The durable run log tail, or `{available: false, reason}`.

health.description: The requested one-off probe result; present when `health_check` was sent.

health_monitor.description: The configured policy's latest monitored result.

logs.description: The live terminal tail, or `{available: false, reason}`.

ServiceListRequest.description: `service.list`: a workspace's services and their execution state.

`service.proxy.remap` and `service.proxy.recovery.retry` reply.

ServiceProxyRecoveryInspectRequest.description: `service.proxy.recovery.inspect`: blocked routes or a corrupt registry.

ServiceProxyRecoveryResetRequest.description: `service.proxy.recovery.reset`: archive and reset an inspected corrupt registry.

ServiceProxyRemapRequest.description:

url.description: Null when the route's port is occupied.

ServiceProxyTargetRequest.description:
`service.proxy.target`: the runtime proxy asks the daemon to verify its

`terminal.operation`: read the terminal a `terminal.create` receipt produced.

directory.description: Parent directory for new trees; the repository's parent when absent.

timeout_seconds.description: Git command timeout; the daemon accepts 5 to 300.

WorktreeOperation.description: One lifecycle operation from the ledger. The daemon stores this shape.

request.description: The request as the caller sent it, including `op`.

result.description:
Command output and its `value`; `null` until the command runs.
`worktree_state` omits `stdout` and `stderr`.

WorktreeOperationRequest.description: `worktree.operation`: read one lifecycle operation receipt in full.

operation_id.description: The operation's ID; `request_id` is accepted as an alias.

WorktreeOperationStatus.description: A lifecycle operation's status in its ledger.

oneOf.description: The tree was removed but its branch was kept.
The daemon stopped while the operation ran; inspect before retrying.

WorktreeRebindCandidate.description: One lifecycle repository in the rebind catalog.

rebindable.description: Whether the saved source identity survives, so a rebind can be verified.

WorktreeRebindListRequest.description: `worktree.rebind.list`: list lifecycle repositories and whether each needs a rebind.

WorktreeRebindRequest.description: `worktree.rebind`: bind a restored lifecycle repository to a verified checkout.

WorktreeRefreshRequest.description: `worktree.refresh`: re-read the Git worktree listing under the repository lock.

operation_id.description: Caller-owned operation ID; `request_id` is accepted as an alias.

WorktreeRemoveRequest.description: `worktree.remove`: remove a clean ADE-owned linked tree.

delete_branch.description:
Branch policy; the daemon uses `keep` when it is absent. The daemon
reads the raw string so an unknown policy keeps its own error message.

force.description: Forced removal is unavailable; `true` is rejected.

operation_id.description: Caller-owned operation ID; `request_id` is accepted as an alias.

WorktreeRepository.description: A registered lifecycle repository. Device and inode identities are decimal strings.

root.description: The primary checkout, where lifecycle commands run.

source_common_dir.description: The common directory before the first rebind.

WorktreeRepositoryRequest.description:
`worktree.repository`: register the Git repository containing `path`, or
return the one already registered for its common directory.

WorktreeState.description:
A repository's lifecycle state: the reply to every command except
`worktree.operation` and `worktree.rebind.list`.

busy.description: Whether a lifecycle or review operation holds the repository.

operations.description: The newest 100 operations, newest first, without command output.

worktrees.description: The cached Git listing, primary checkout first.

WorktreeSwitchRequest.description:
`worktree.switch`: check out `target` in a linked tree, creating the branch
when `create` is true.

base.description: Start point for a new branch; the daemon uses `HEAD` when it is absent.

operation_id.description: Caller-owned operation ID; `request_id` is accepted as an alias.

path.description: Absolute path for a new tree, directly inside the configured directory.

target.description: A branch name, or the path of an existing linked tree.
